source: USDA-NRCS SSURGO via Soil Data Access
queries:
SELECT TOP 5 mu.mukey, mu.muname, mu.muacres, l.areaname, l.areasymbol, sc.saverest, c.cokey, c.compname,
c.comppct_r, c.majcompflag, c.taxclname, c.hydgrp, c.slope_r, c.drainagecl
FROM legend l JOIN mapunit mu ON mu.lkey = l.lkey JOIN sacatalog sc ON sc.areasymbol = l.areasymbol
JOIN component c ON c.mukey = mu.mukey
WHERE l.areasymbol = 'IA015' AND c.compname = 'Clarion'
AND c.comppct_r = (SELECT MAX(c2.comppct_r) FROM component c2 WHERE c2.mukey = mu.mukey)
ORDER BY mu.muacres DESC

SELECT hzname, hzdept_r, hzdepb_r, dbthirdbar_r, wthirdbar_r, wfifteenbar_r, wsatiated_r, ksat_r,
om_r, ph1to1h2o_r, claytotal_r, silttotal_r, sandtotal_r FROM chorizon WHERE cokey = '{cokey}' ORDER BY hzdept_r
SELECT cokey, reskind, resdept_r, resdepb_r FROM corestrictions WHERE cokey IN ({keys})
